name: material-opencode-deploy
description: One-click deployment of the Material OpenCode web app and appliance image

scripts.build: bun build src/main.ts src/preload.ts --outdir dist --target node --format cjs --external electron && bun build src/renderer/app.ts --outdir dist/renderer --target browser && cp src/renderer/index.html src/renderer/styles.css dist/renderer/
scripts.dist:win: bun run build && bun run bundle && electron-builder --win portable --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: bun run build && bun run bundle && electron-builder --linux AppImage --x64 --publish never
